items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: You know Matt Catingub the saxophone player? ... Matt is a brilliant young saxophone player. He lives in Vegas, and a writer and all of that. He was on Louie Bellson’s band and all of that.

ctx.x: Oh yes she was a great singer. She’s from Samoa. Yeah. You know Matt Catingub the saxophone player?
